## 中文原文

你洗完澡出来，觉得房间有点闷，就把窗户打开透透气。然后去阳台把晾干的衣服收下来，一件件叠好，分别放进衣柜和抽屉。弄完之后觉得有点累，就坐在椅子上喝了杯温水，歇了一会儿。

## English translation

After I got out of the shower, I felt the room was a bit stuffy, so I opened the window to air it out.

Then I went out to the balcony, brought in the dry laundry, folded everything up one by one, and put them away in the closet and drawers.

I was feeling a bit tired afterward, so I sat down with a glass of warm water and relaxed for a bit.
